headline: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas, Trilegal, Linklaters act on Bajaj Finance ₹11,700 crore QIP

detail: Bajaj Finance Limited has made a qualified institutions placement of equity shares aggregating to ₹11,700 crore. Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Bajaj Finance on this QIP, as well as on the preferential issuance of fully convertible warrants to its promoter and holding company, Bajaj Finserv Limited aggregating to ₹5,800 crore. The transaction was led by S. Vivek (Partner), with support from Vishesh Jain (Senior Associate), Associates Dhruv Sharma, Mohnish Khandale, Namita Kaushik, Siddharth Kaushik, Aditi Joshi and Avani Hegde.
